description.zh:
认证请求ID。
必须先调用初始化接口InitCardVerify提交认证请求，才能获得认证请求ID。
description.en:
The verification request ID.
You must first call the InitCardVerify operation to submit a verification request before you can obtain the verification request ID.

descriptions.zh: 当您收到回调通知之后，可以在服务端通过该接口获取相应的认证状态和认证资料。
descriptions.en: After you receive a callback notification, you can call this operation on the server side to obtain the corresponding verification status and verification materials.
